subject: Acme Retail POC — playbook review, load day & stakeholder roster
body:
---Message 1 (original)---
From: Elaine Park <elaine@acme-retail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff — next steps and timeline

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to kick off the POC. We wanted to propose a kickoff next Tuesday (10/5) but several stakeholders are traveling. Can we move the kickoff to the following week?

Key asks for the kickoff: stakeholder intros (tech + procurement), a short review of the playbook, and to lock the load-testing day so we can notify our infra team.

Available windows: 10/12 AM PT (9–11a) or 10/13 PM PT (4–6p). Let me know what works on your side.

Cheers,
Elaine Park
Head of Data Products
Acme Retail
Attach: procurement-checklist.pdf (referenced)

---Message 2 (reply)---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff — next steps and timeline

Hi Elaine — great to hear. 10/12 AM PT works for our core team, but Markus (SE) asked for a quick cadence check because we may need a separate slot for the heavy load test.

Proposed plan:
- Kickoff (stakeholder intros + playbook review): 10/12 9:30–10:30 AM PT
- Hands-on lab / prompt walk-through: 10/12 11:00–12:00 PM PT (optional)
- Dedicated load-testing day: propose 10/14 (full day) — we'll coordinate exact windows once infra confirms.

Monica — can you own the kickoff agenda and send calendar invites? Aditya — can you finalize the mutual action plan before the call? Markus — see note below about load profile.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

---Message 3 (internal add)---
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff — next steps and timeline

Thanks Jordan — putting draft invites together now. Draft kickoff agenda (30–45 min):
1) Introductions & roles (10m) — Elaine to introduce stakeholders
2) Success criteria & acceptance signals (10m) — outline target latency and correctness thresholds
3) Playbook & architecture overview (10m) — how Redwood will route/quantize/cache for cost targets
4) Next steps & lab scheduling (5–15m)

Attachments: Acme_Playbook_v1.2.pdf (see section 3 for routing recommendations)

Elaine — can you confirm the names and titles of the folks who should be present for the intro? Also, do you have any calendar blackout dates for 10/14?

Will send invites once I have confirmation on attendees.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

---Message 4 (internal technical)---
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine@acme-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff — next steps and timeline

Quick technical note on load-testing day: to replicate Acme's peak experience we need the following from your infra team:
- Target concurrency: 120 concurrent sessions (95th percentile within 200ms baseline)
- Average request tokens: ~350, peak 1,200 (prompt + completion)
- KV cache hit-rate target (if you enable prefix caching): 60–80%

If they can provide a small VPN endpoint and an allowlist for our test runner, we can run an end-to-end test without exposing production keys. I attached a small sample load profile (load-profile-sample.json).

Markus Klein
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attach: load-profile-sample.json (attachment)

---Message 5 (external confirmation + attendees)---
From: Elaine Park <elaine@acme-retail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-retail.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff — next steps and timeline

Thanks — confirmed attendees below:
- Elaine Park, Head of Data Products (Acme)
- Tomas Li, VP Engineering (tomas.li@acme-retail.com)
- Claire Montgomery, Procurement (procurement@acme-retail.com)
- Victor Chen, Platform Ops (victor.chen@acme-retail.com)

10/12 9:30–10:30 AM PT works for everyone for the kickoff. 10/14 looks good for load-testing but Victor will confirm time windows tomorrow.

Also: procurement attached a brief checklist — I added it to the drive.

Best,
Elaine

---Message 6 (final internal invite & MAP)---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@acme-retail.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Acme POC — calendar invites and mutual action plan

Hi all — per thread, calendar invites have been sent for:
- Kickoff: 10/12/2026 09:30–10:30 AM PT (Meet link + agenda in invite)
- Optional lab: 10/12/2026 11:00–12:00 PM PT (hands-on prompt review)

I've uploaded the mutual action plan and the playbook to the shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/acme/poc-playbook (internal + read-only link for Acme).

Action items before kickoff:
- Acme: confirm Victor's available windows for 10/14 load day and provide VPN allowlist (Victor)
- Acme: sign & return procurement checklist (Claire)
- Redwood: provide a small runner AMI and test-run instructions (Markus)

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (attachment)

See you on 10/12 — please reply if any calendar conflicts come up.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

[End of thread]
